Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 44
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Agenda
Tuesday, Bhadra 30, 2083
1:00 PM
(Tentative)
Ministry-wise Question and Answer
Regarding the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Ministry of Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration, and Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
1. The concerned Minister will answer oral questions related to the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Ministry of Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration, and Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Discussion and Approval of Convention
Honorable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam:
2. (a) "Be it discussed in the House with Nepal Government's declaration of its accession to the Convention relating to the obtaining of membership of the Council of Asian Legislative Institutions (CALI)."
(b) "Be it approved with Nepal Government's declaration of its accession to the Convention relating to the obtaining of membership of the Council of Asian Legislative Institutions (CALI)."

Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
